definitions: A secure network connection that allows a user to access a private network and its resources over a public network, often used to refer to the entire secure network setup within an organization.
The collective infrastructure and policies that define the secure, private network space of an organization, accessible typically via a Virtual Private Network.
examples: Accessing the VPN/internal environment requires multi-factor authentication.
The new employee needs credentials for the VPN/internal environment.
Security protocols for the VPN/internal environment are regularly updated.
